last_checked.description: Date and time of the last metadata check.

sources.description: List of URLs that were used for metadata discovery, such as API URLs or PR URLs for manual edits.

typeRef.title: Type Ref
typeRef.description: Type references with optional constraints. Keys are type names, values are either null or objects with constraint properties such as version.

notable.description: List of IDs of artifacts or repositories that this artifact incorporates or references.

instantiates.description: Types that this artifact instantiates (e.g., software package, service image or template, capabilities pipeline, build tools) with optional version constraints.

requires.description: Requirements for instantiation including environment context and types of software or services with optional version constraints. Non-exhaustive, for example, the type may imply additional requirements.

source.description: The source code and build provenance of the artifact. Omitted if the artifact ID is a direct reference to a file path in a repository.

location.description: Repository URL pointing to source code.

revision.description: Source control revision identifier for the packaged software.

provenance.description: URL to documents with build provenance or SBOM, such as in-toto build provenance statement.

reproducible.description: Indicates whether this artifact is fully reproducible when rebuilt from source.

immutable.description: Indicates whether the artifact identifier refers to an artifact that will not change.

created.description: Date and time on which the artifact was built, conforming to RFC 3339.

platforms.description: List of platforms this artifact supports.

spdx_licenses.description: License(s) under which the artifact is distributed as an SPDX License Expression.

vendor.description: Name of the distributing entity, organization, or individual.

version.description: Version of the packaged software. The version may match a label or tag in the source code repository or may be Semantic Versioning-compatible.

homepage_url.description: URL to find more information on the artifact.

documentation_url.description: URL to get documentation on the artifact.

thumbnail_url.description: Icon or thumbnail representing the artifact.

releases.description: Artifacts that are variants of this artifact. Each artifact inherits the metadata of this one unless overridden in its declaration. Identifiers should share the base ID as this package. If releases share the same digest, the artifact identifier refers to the same physical artifact, such as a tagged container image.

propertyNames.description: A PURL identifier or another URL if the artifact is of a type not supported by PURL.
URL of the repository using the git:// URL scheme.

path.description: Project path relative to base location of git repositories on the host.

initial_revision.description: Initial commit hash when the repository was first added to the cloudmap.

protocols.description: List of protocols available to clone the repository (e.g., https, ssh).

internal_id.description: Internal identifier from the repository host (e.g., GitHub repository ID).

project_url.description: URL to the repository's project page on the host (e.g., https://github.com/user/repo).

mirror_of.description: URL of the repository that this repository is a mirror of.

fork_of.description: URL of the repository that this repository was forked from.

metadata.description: Metadata about the repository that isn't stored in the git repository itself but might be provided by the host (e.g., metadata found on the repository's GitHub or GitLab project page).

topics.description: List of topic tags associated with the repository.

spdx_licenses.description: License(s) under which the repository contents are distributed as an SPDX License Expression.

license_url.description: URL to the license file or license information.

issues_url.description: URL to the issue tracker for the repository.

thumbnail_url.description: URL to an avatar, icon, or thumbnail image representing the repository.

lastupdate_time.description: Timestamp of the last metadata update.

lastupdate_digest.description: Digest hash of the metadata at the time of the last update.

project_status.description: Project status as defined by https://www.repostatus.org

branches.description: Map of branch names to their commit SHA hashes.

additionalProperties.description: Commit SHA hash for the branch.

tags.description: Map of tag names to their commit SHA hashes.

additionalProperties.description: Commit SHA hash for the tag.

oneOf.description: Links to artifacts like blueprints or Helm charts when origin information is unavailable.

artifacts.description: Instantiates (implements) node types. Artifact ID is either a package URL (https://github.com/package-url/purl-spec) or repository URL with path.

propertyNames.description: A PURL identifier or another URL if the artifact is of a type not supported by PURL.

services.description: Instances of types, instantiated from artifacts.

type.description: Type identifier from types/services with optional version constraints.

capabilities.description: Capability types from types/capabilities with optional version constraints.

dependencies.description: List of other services this service depends on.

vendor.description: Name of the distributing entity, organization, or individual.

version.description: Version of the service. The version may match a label or tag in the source code repository or may be Semantic Versioning-compatible.

documentation_url.description: URL to get documentation on the service.

thumbnail_url.description: Icon or thumbnail representing the service.

source_url.description: Informal pointer to source code. Use when deployment information is not available.

notable.description: Links to artifacts like blueprints or Helm charts when origin information is unavailable.

spdx_licenses.description: License(s) under which the service is distributed as an SPDX License Expression.

terms_of_service.description: URL to the terms of service.

deployment.description: Ensemble or artifact representing the actual deployment.

location.description: Location of the deployment blueprint or ensemble.

types.description: Type definitions for artifacts, services, software, and capabilities.

kind.description: One of: Service, Software, Artifact, or Capability.

source.description: Artifact containing type definition. Include if it cannot be derived from the type name.

extends.description: List of fully-qualified type names that this type extends.
